audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts read Skill/Illaoi/Illaoi/Skill/Skill/Illaoi/Illaoi while the whys[] beside them said the opposite on four rows — 'You out-trade Illaoi at level 1' sat on a Skill row, 'fighting near her tentacles shreds and heals her past you' and 'any brawl in the zone is a loss for you' sat on Skill rows, and 'Late game turns skill-based' sat on an Illaoi row.
audit.why: The mirror (illaoi__sett) settled rows 0 and 1 to Sett, rows 3 and 4 to Illaoi, and row 6 to Skill. That matches the prose on this page for rows 0, 3, 4 and 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved to match, phase whys rewritten, and whys[1] restated to the new owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns appeared, and the level-6 row was written as a Sett spike ('you can start fights Illaoi doesn't want') when level 6 is her strongest moment in the lane.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range — the one cooldown the whole lane turns on. Harsh Lesson is a 4s, 400-range leap, so she is never far away. Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s and spawns a tentacle for every champion it hits.
audit.corrected: Test of Spirit's 16s at rank 1 and 900 range keyed to the Levels 4-5 line and the first-item spike; Harsh Lesson's 400-range leap keyed to level 2; Leap of Faith's tentacle-per-champion behaviour written into the level-6 phase and spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 advice told the player to use R to flip her out of her own tentacle field, without saying that Illaoi is untargetable through the Leap of Faith smash — so the reader spends a 120s ultimate into a window where it cannot land.
audit.why: Illaoi R carries the untargetable flag and Riot's text describes the idol smash; the missing-interactions file lists 'untargetable-dodges-burst' as applicable to exactly this matchup. Waiting the animation out and then carrying her costs nothing; committing into it costs the ultimate.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and spikes[1] now say hold The Show Stopper until the smash ends, then carry her out of the field.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two more applicable missing interactions were absent: Prophet of an Elder God heals Illaoi whenever a tentacle damages a champion, and Harsh Lesson opens her combo with an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: The healing is why extended trades near terrain are unwinnable regardless of how much Grit you bank — the tentacles refund her the whole exchange. The reset means her leap animation is the tell, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into the first-item spike with the reason attached; the auto-reset tell added to the level 3-5 spike. The itemization line already recommended Executioner's Calling but called Illaoi 'his' — pronoun fixed.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Illaoi and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before she can answer with Test of Spirit.
edits.after: Knuckle Down's two punches beat her at 2 — Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap, so she has to come into your range to trade with you at all.

edits.before: Facebreaker is online — the E-stun into double punch + W is your full pattern. Run it the moment Illaoi burns Test of Spirit.
edits.after: Her tentacles start to matter — every Harsh Lesson makes them swing at you, and each hit heals her. Trade only away from the terrain.

edits.before: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier, but Illaoi has her core tools too. Keep the grit bar honest: trade in, W-shield her return damage, out.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 and reaches 900 — eat the spirit near her tentacles and the echoed damage plus her healing outlasts anything you bank.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Illaoi doesn't want. Suplex her into your wave or tower, never into her own minions.
edits.after: Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle per champion hit and she is untargetable through the smash — do not spend R into it, wait the field out.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Test of Spirit and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable, but terrain decides it: caught in open ground she loses, caught among her tentacles you do.

edits.before: Level 2 is a skill window as her first tentacle starts to matter.
edits.after: Level 2 stays yours — she must step into melee for Harsh Lesson.

edits.before: Illaoi's tentacles come online — never trade inside a cluster of them, and dodge her E Test of Spirit; if she hits your spirit, disengage instantly since every tentacle slam shreds your health and heals her.
edits.after: Illaoi's tentacles come online — never trade inside a cluster, and dodge Test of Spirit; if she hits your spirit, disengage. Harsh Lesson is an auto reset, so her leap animation is the cue to step back.

edits.before: Her R Leap of Faith spawns a wall of tentacles — do not fight in it. Use your R The Show Stopper to flip her OUT of her own tentacle field rather than brawling in it.
edits.after: Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle for every champion it hits, and she is untargetable through the smash — hold The Show Stopper until it ends, then carry her out of the field.

edits.before: Illaoi out-sustains and out-damages you in any prolonged fight near tentacles; only all-in when her E is down and you can drag her away from the slams.
edits.after: Illaoi out-sustains you near tentacles — every one that lands on you heals her. Buy Grievous Wounds, and all-in only with Test of Spirit (16s) down and open ground behind you.

edits.before: You edge level 1 before her tentacles matter — Q Knuckle Down and an E pull punish her, but this is your only clean window so trade hard early and soak Grit.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours before her tentacles matter — Knuckle Down and a Facebreaker pull punish her, and it is your only clean window, so trade hard and soak Grit.

edits.before: To ult a wave and drown you in tentacles
edits.after: To catch you in R and stack tentacles

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + Health Potion. Core: Stridebreaker  (stick to them through the W panel window), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — his healing out-paces your grit trades.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + Health Potion. Core: Stridebreaker (stick to her through the W panel window), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — her tentacle healing out-paces your grit trades.

notes: Row 1 is a genuine conflict I resolved toward the mirror, and the user should know: this brief's packet chart says Level 2 is 'Skill', and this page's own whys[1] said 'Level 2 is a skill window', but the mirror (illaoi__sett) states it settled rows 0 AND 1 to Sett and that its chart matches its packet. Two packets therefore disagree about row 1. I followed the mirror so the two directions do not contradict, and rewrote whys[1] to match — if the packet here is authoritative, row 1 needs flipping back to Skill on BOTH pages together. Carried forward from the mirror and still unverified: spikes[1] and wants.foe[2] previously described The Show Stopper as a 'suppression'. Riot's text says only that Sett carries and slams the target, so I neither asserted nor removed the claim; I rewrote around it using 'carry', which is what the kit actually says.
